headline: Turkey says the PKK has evacuated fourteen more bases in northern Iraq
label: NEWS
caption:
Turkey announced a major development in the ongoing peace process with the group 🕊️

According to Al Monitor and Arab News, Turkey stated that the PKK has evacuated 14 more bases in northern Iraq.

The evacuations come amid advancements in the peace process between Turkish authorities and the group.
